name: Amazon PPC launch builder
why: Plans auto, keyword and competitor campaigns with bids, negatives and a stop rule from your unit profit, the core of a launch build.

name: Amazon unit profit checker
why: Works out profit per unit and break-even ad cost from your price, landed cost and fees, before any ACOS is judged.

name: Amazon fee and margin checker
why: Lists every Amazon fee for a product and gives break-even ad cost, for products you haven't costed yet.

name: Amazon keyword picker
why: Filters keyword exports into phrases worth using, a good seed list for manual campaigns.

name: Amazon launch week planner
why: Plans the weeks before a launch and the launch day, so the ad plan sits inside a full launch with honest review steps.

name: Amazon monthly account keeper
why: Checks margins, stock and refund claims each month, the numbers the monthly margin review depends on.

name: Amazon search gap finder
why: Finds searches page 1 doesn't serve well, which can become new keyword and product targeting tests.

name: Star-rating review miner
why: Mines rival reviews for gaps and buyer phrases, useful for Sponsored Brands headlines and negative themes.

name: Platform ROAS reality check
why: Compares the return an ad platform reports with your store totals, the same habit as checking TACOS against ad-attributed sales.

name: Channel budget mix planner
why: Helps decide how much of the total ad budget Amazon should get against other channels, before setting monthly caps.
